_instructions.usage: Copy this file to docs/state_machine_migrate/audit/manual-gates.json and replace every false/empty value with real evidence before destructive cleanup.
_instructions.evidence_format: Evidence values must be http(s) URLs or existing docs/state_machine_migrate/ paths.
_instructions.time_format: confirmed_at and smoke_at must be parseable date-time strings, preferably ISO 8601 with timezone, and must not be in the future.
_instructions.version_format: minimum_version must be a numeric version string such as 2.8.0.
